description: This file defines classes and functions for managing cache artifacts in PyTorch, including serialization, deserialization, and registration of cache artifact types. It is part of the internal caching mechanism for the torch compiler.

classes.name: CacheArtifact
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a cache artifact, with methods for serialization and cache population.

classes.name: CacheArtifactFactory
classes.description: Factory class for registering and creating cache artifact instances based on their type.

classes.name: CacheInfo
classes.description: Data structure for holding cache artifact keys, with methods for adding, clearing, and checking if empty.

classes.name: CacheArtifactManager
classes.description: Manager class for collecting, serializing, deserializing, and populating cache artifacts for hot loading.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes all collected cache artifacts into a portable byte format.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes cache artifacts from a byte stream back into cache artifact objects.

methods.name: populate_caches
methods.description: Populates cache structures from deserialized cache artifacts.

methods.name: record_artifact
methods.description: Records a cache artifact of a specific type with a key and content.

methods.name: need_serialize
methods.description: Checks if there are new cache artifacts that need serialization.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all cache artifacts and internal state.

methods.name: with_fresh_cache
methods.description: Context manager to reset cache state temporarily.

methods.name: _ensure_cache_artifacts_registered
methods.description: Ensures all cache artifact types are registered before deserialization.
